scope: actors end cannot be measured with the safe breakpoints; switch to a length sweep as the acceptance oracle

run.note: only ps/actors are traced; the glass breakpoint is unsafe, so the actors END is not directly observable

constraint: the actors block sets the stream error when it reads past the body, so the snapshot is rejected whenever the actors payload does not terminate it
the baseline (has-ps=0) terminates actors within 27 bits; with has-ps=1 the same 27 bits at the actors start make it consume 46+ bits
therefore the actors terminator depends on ps content, not only on the tail bits

plan.method: length sweep as an acceptance oracle
plan.detail: build bodies with L zero tail bits for L in a range (e.g. 27, 40, 60, 80, 100, 130) placed before the 0x05 EOF, run them all in one session, and record which L yields state 10
plan.why: state 10 is only reached when every block parses AND the EOF check passes, so an accepted L pins down the actors+glass length exactly
